verses.text: <pb/><t>Allah ne mafakarmu da ƙarfinmu,</t> <t>Kullum a shirye yake yă yi taimako a lokacin wahala.</t>
<t>Saboda haka ba za mu ji tsoro ba,</t> <t>Ko da duniya za ta girgiza,</t> <t>Duwatsu kuma su fāɗa cikin zurfafan teku,</t>
<t>Ko da a ce tekuna za su yi ruri su tumbatsa,</t> <t>Tuddai kuma su girgiza saboda tangaɗin tekun. <pb/></t>
<t>Akwai kogin da yake kawo farin ciki a birnin Allah,</t> <t>Da cikin tsattsarkan Haikali na Maɗaukaki.</t>
<t>Allah yana zaune cikin birnin,</t> <t>Ba kuwa za a hallaka birnin ba, faufau.</t> <t>Da asuba Allah zai kawo musu gudunmawa.</t>
<t>An kaɓantar da sauran al'umma, mulkoki suka girgiza,</t> <t>Allah ya yi tsawa, duniya kuwa ta narke. <pb/></t>
<t>Ubangiji Maɗaukaki yana tare da mu,</t> <t>Allah na Yakubu shi ne mafakarmu! <pb/></t>
<t>Zo ku ga abin da Ubangiji ya yi!</t> <t>Dubi irin ayyukan al'ajabi da ya yi a duniya!</t>
<t>Ya hana yaƙoƙi ko'ina a duniya,</t> <t>Yana karya bakkuna, yana lalatar da māsu,</t> <t>Yana ƙone karusai da wuta.</t>
<t>Ya ce, “Ku yi shiru, ku sani ni ne Allah,</t> <t>Maɗaukaki ne cikin sauran al'umma,</t> <t>Maɗaukaki kuma a duniya!” <pb/></t>
<t>Ubangiji Maɗaukaki yana tare da mu,</t> <t>Allah na Yakubu shi ne mafakarmu!</t>
